sections.name: Abstract
sections.text: This note describes a small research assistant that reads a closed set of papers. The assistant writes an answer only after retrieval. A later check removes any sentence that the cited passage does not state.

sections.name: Method
sections.text: Reciprocal rank fusion combines a keyword list from BM25 and a dense list from embeddings. Each list contributes one divided by sixty plus the rank. Citation verification labels a sentence supported only when the cited passage states the claim. The assistant abstains when the best fused score is below a threshold chosen on a development set. The planned evaluation uses a frozen subset of questions about NLP papers. Faithfulness asks whether the answer stays inside the retrieved context.

sections.name: Abstract
sections.text: This note describes tomato leaf disease classification from a single uploaded photograph. The photograph shows one leaf. The output is a class label for that leaf.

sections.name: Method
sections.text: Accuracy is the reported metric for this tomato leaf disease model. A convolutional network classifies each leaf photograph as early blight or a healthy leaf. The dataset contains field photographs of leaves taken in daylight. The authors state that the model fails on dark images. This note does not study citation checks.
